replaceWhen: once the rest of the app is built
qualityWarning: mono source duplicated to stereo, loses spatial width
notes: Re-encoded from Pixabay source: 5s head trim, 3s fades each end, mono->stereo if needed, loudnorm -23 LUFS, 48 kHz 192 kbps MP3. Seamless-looped to 409s (prime loopOffset) for native Howler looping: 6s fade-wrap of the post-loop tail over the head so the loop point is gapless.

tonalRepair.why: Narrow tonal intrusions (bird calls) audible on every loop. The FTUS source name for the rain-on-glass takes reads 'Birds and Crows', so they were documented at selection and missed. Spectral repair rather than a re-cut: sample count and the gapless 6s fade-wrap are preserved exactly, so the prime loop offset and seam are untouched.
tonalRepair.cost: One extra generation of Opus 128k across the whole file, unavoidable when the source is already lossy. Integrated loudness unchanged at measurement precision.
